run_print_config: run the print_config tool to display the full configuration from a config file path
run_print_config_with_options: run the print_config tool with --cfg-options to override settings in the config file
parse_args_config: parse command line arguments for config file path and optional cfg-options overrides
merge_cfg_options: merge command line cfg-options into an mmengine Config object using merge_from_dict
print_config_pretty_text: print the pretty formatted text of an mmengine Config object using rich console
